data.name: Mushtaqi
data.gender_notes: Mushtaqi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sh-t-q', which means 'to long for, to desire, to yearn for, or to aspire to'. The name Mushtaqi signifies someone who is longing for, desiring, or aspiring towards Allah (God). The name Mushtaqi carries the meaning “Longing, Desiring” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mushtaqi usually hope their child will grow to embody longing, desiring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the deep longing and yearning of a believer for Allah's love and guidance.
data.etymology: Mushtaqi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Longing, Desiring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mushtaqi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
